status.queuedLowMemory: Queued · the computer is low on memory; starts once memory frees up

failure.stalled: No progress for a long time

advice.auth: Run the matching CLI once on that machine as the same user to sign in.
advice.authClaude: Tasks Aide hands out run with the Claude Code command line, which is not signed in on that machine (the Claude desktop app's sign-in does not carry over). The sign-in button below gives a sign-in address to open on any device; sign in, enter the code back, then send a message to go on.
advice.quota: Try again when the quota resets, or switch agents or models.
advice.transient: Temporary issue. Try sending the message again in a moment.
advice.newContext: Send another message to continue in a fresh context. Your worktree changes are preserved.
advice.modelUnavailable: Start a new task with another model.
advice.resume: Send another message to resume the task.
advice.startFailed: Open that machine’s page in Aide Settings to check why it can’t start agents.
advice.baseRefUnavailable: Check the base ref name, and that the branch or tag is on the project’s remote (the machine fetches it from there). Then send another message in this task to retry the original request.
advice.missingCredentials: Add the API key in {{agent}}’s model settings.
advice.missingCredentials_provider: Add the {{provider}} API key in {{agent}}’s model settings.
advice.details: The original message is in Details.

headline.stalled: {{agent}} made no progress for a long time
headline.timeout: This turn ran past its time limit
headline.baseRefUnavailable: The worktree’s base ref was not found
headline.missingCredentials: {{agent}} has no API key for its model service

notice.quietTitle: {{agent}} has been quiet for two minutes
notice.quietBody: “{{title}}” was handed out two minutes ago and nothing has come from it yet.

resolution.timedOut: No response received; the agent continued on its own

conn.machineAway: The machine can't be reached now: last known “{{text}}” ({{when}})
conn.stale: Last checked {{when}}, not confirmed since (it said “{{text}}”)
conn.desktopSignedOut: Sign in in the Claude desktop app: its own sessions show in Aide only then.
conn.cliSignedOutDesktopIn: Claude Desktop is signed in, but tasks Aide hands out run with the Claude Code command line, which keeps its own sign-in: the app's does not carry over. Sign it in below (it gives a sign-in address to open on any device); the app and its sessions are not touched.
conn.cliSignedOut: Tasks Aide hands out run with the Claude Code command line, which is not signed in: sign it in below (it gives a sign-in address to open on any device).
conn.cliUnconfirmed: The Claude Code command line did not say whether it is signed in, and Aide does not take the Claude desktop app's sign-in for it: whether tasks can run with it is not confirmed. Sign it in below (it gives a sign-in address to open on any device), or check again.
conn.appWithoutCLI: Only the Claude desktop app is here, not the Claude Code command line Aide runs: open Code in the Claude app once and it fetches it.
conn.cliNotFound: Tasks for Claude run with the Claude Code command line, which is not on this machine.

bridgeState.installRestart: Installed, waiting for DSH Desktop to restart

conn.bridgeGap: Works: DSH tasks Aide starts. Doesn't: seeing or taking over the sessions you open in DSH Desktop yourself, until the plugin is installed. Press “Have DSH install it”: DSH installs it, restarts, and tells Aide when it is done.
conn.bridgeNotRunning: Open DSH Desktop (with the plugin turned on) to see and take over its own sessions.
conn.bridgeOutdated: The old one can't take over sessions: press “Have DSH install it” and DSH puts in the new one.
conn.agentSignedOut: {{agent}} is installed but not signed in: no task can go to it here.
conn.agentUnconfirmed: Whether {{agent}} is signed in shows only when it runs a task: not confirmed yet. Tasks can go to it; once one runs, this says signed in, and if it is not signed in the task says so.
conn.loginWaitingHint: Starting Claude Code's sign-in, waiting for its sign-in address…
conn.loginUrlHint: Open the sign-in address below on any device, sign in, then enter the code the page shows here. Good for 15 minutes.
conn.loginCodeHint: The code went to Claude Code; checking it…
conn.loginFailed: The last sign-in didn't finish: {{why}}. Try again.
conn.loginTimedOut: The last sign-in was not finished within 15 minutes and was stopped. Try again.
conn.bridgeInstalling: DSH installs the plugin on that computer and restarts DSH Desktop; it tells Aide when it is done, and this line updates by itself.
conn.bridgeInstallFailed: DSH didn't install it and didn't say why: open its install task to see how far it got.
conn.bridgeInstallRestart: Takes effect once DSH Desktop restarts (this line turns “Installed” as soon as the plugin answers).

roster.pausedLine: Paused: no new task starts with it until it resumes
roster.reconnectingLine: The link to Aide on this computer broke and is being restored; what it showed before is not known to be current.

attach.tooMany: {{kind}} “{{name}}” was not added: a message takes at most {{max}} attachments
attach.tooBig: {{kind}} “{{name}}” was not added: a message’s attachments add up to {{max}} at most
attach.imageTooBig: Over 3.5 MB: it gets the file, not the picture to look at
attach.imageFormat: In this format it gets the file, not the picture to look at

permission.above: Above the DSH permission project “{{project}}” sets (“{{preset}}”): this task runs with “{{mode}}”, as you chose
